svg.title: 19 Agent Observability — Trace Store, Dashboard, and the Two Drift Detectors
svg.desc: One Node process that fabricates 500 agent traces into SQLite, then serves them over 13 HTTP routes to a browser page. Drawn as it is wired, not as the README describes it: the OpenTelemetry-style tracer is never instantiated, drift is detected twice by two different formulas, and the browser reads field names the API never sends. Every element cites a source line in FACTS.md.

g.text: ③ Entry — CLI + a dead SDK
① 19-agent-observability — one Node ESM process (no LLM call, no network egress)
② Browser — the only real network hop
④ stdout — what a human sees
DRIFT — injected in 4 places, detected by 2
writes pct INTO the z_score column :331
5 metrics :1 x each agent x model :209
ZERO construction sites in the repo
table with no writer and no reader
THE PAGE READS FIELDS THE API NEVER SENDS
attribution :600. The rest are read raw.
trace_id; store.js:5-16 has no such column.
